name: Compiled program G
arch:
A 1-layer transformer with no LayerNorm. Vocabulary of 6 tokens; the input is a sequence of 6 tokens; residual stream width 19.
  x = W_E[tokens] + W_pos
  layer 0: attention (1 head of size 6, bidirectional, biases b_Q, b_K, b_V, b_O): x = x + softmax((x W_Q + b_Q)(x W_K + b_K)^T / sqrt(6)) (x W_V + b_V) W_O + b_O;  then MLP (12 ReLU neurons): x = x + relu(x W_in + b_in) W_out + b_out
  output = x[positions 1..5] @ W_U: 6 numbers for each of the last 5 positions, flattened as (position - 1) * 6 + class. The network's decision at a position is its largest of those 6 numbers.
context: Token 4 is a begin-of-sequence marker and always comes first; tokens [0, 1, 2, 3] stand for [1, 2, 3, 4]. Output class c at a position stands for the value ['0', '1', '2', '3', '4', '5'][c].

answer.short: output i is the number of tokens greater than token i
answer.detail: Custom RASP program: one attention head attends from each position to the positions holding a greater token (and to BOS); the weight on BOS is 1/(count+1); an MLP turns that into the count. Compiled by Tracr; residual labels before rotation: ['indices:0', 'indices:1', 'indices:2', 'indices:3', 'indices:4', 'n_greater_12:0', 'n_greater_12:1', 'n_greater_12:2', 'n_greater_12:3', 'n_greater_12:4', 'n_greater_12:5', 'n_greater_12_selector_width_attn_output', 'one', 'tokens:1', 'tokens:2', 'tokens:3', 'tokens:4', 'tokens:BOS', 'tokens:compiler_pad'].

source: Compiled with Tracr (Lindner et al. 2023) in lab/targets/build_tracr.py; residual stream rotated, MLP neurons permuted and rescaled.

domain.text: The network is used on every input [4, t1, ..., t5] where each of t1..t5 is one of the tokens [0, 1, 2, 3] (1,024 inputs).
